rules.statement: A route map in which two routes may match one request (same method, paths not provably disjoint) does not load: a request has one action and one resource.
guards: document:RouteMapTest#routes one request could match do not load, whatever their actions

rules.statement: A captured path value that holds a slash (a decoded %2F) never becomes a segment of a typed resource id: the request is refused with 400.
guards: document:RouteMapTest#a capture that decodes to a slash never becomes a segment of a resource id
runtime:PipelineRoutesTest#a capture holding a slash is refused, never read as another resource

rules.statement: A malformed route map, one with any malformed route, or one with no routes does not load: a route map loads whole or not at all.
guards: document:RouteMapTest#a malformed route does not load
document:RouteMapTest#one bad file fails every file, a route map never loads in part
document:RouteMapTest#a route map with no routes does not load

rules.statement: A route map generated from an OpenAPI document places each route at the document's servers path, without the host's context path, and names every path variable of the route, in order, in its resource unless x-cosec-resource says otherwise; servers with different paths, or a server path holding a variable, fail generation.
guards: openapi:OpenAPIServiceGeneratorTest#the servers path prefixes every route
openapi:OpenAPIServiceGeneratorTest#servers whose path cannot be told fail generation
openapi:OpenAPIServiceGeneratorTest#a path with several variables names all of them in its resource, in order
spring-boot:CoSecServiceGeneratorEndpointTest#the routes sit at the servers path within the application
spring-boot:CoSecServiceGeneratorEndpointTest#a request for the API docs does not move the routes
spring-boot:CoSecServiceGeneratorEndpointTest#a request for the API docs leaves the servers an operator wrote

rules.statement: A host with a route map warns, once per installed revision, for a DENY statement or rate limit rule on every action and every resource whose condition reads action.verb, resource.id or resource.var.*: a mapped request has the business action's verb and the route's resource, so such a statement, as a converted 7.x DENY on request.path or request.method is, may stop applying to a mapped route. A statement on a particular action or resource, an ALLOW, and a condition reading anything else are not warned about. The ids it prints are escaped and cut as the escapes of http: statements are (DOC-12).
guards: spring-boot:RouteEscapeReviewTest#a DENY or rate limit rule on every action reading action verb or resource id is warned about
spring-boot:RouteEscapeReviewTest#a statement that is not on every action and resource, an ALLOW, or one reading something else is not
